Players Committee card image of [[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V)]] (original printing), game text: “While opponent's [Reflections II] objective on table, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Dengar's Blaster Carbine (twice per battle, may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target 'hit,' and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/dengarwithblastercarbine.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
